templates.why_chosen: One of the corpus's rare bottom-up host-device figures: a packet climbs from the tan RMT Pipeline through the on-NIC scheduler and load balancer, crosses PCIe, and lands in repeated Core 1...N schedulers above.
templates.what_to_learn: Bottom-up is almost never used in this corpus, but it works here because the physical packet path genuinely rises from NIC to host; if your data truly flows upward, orient the figure that way rather than forcing top-down, and repeat the identical per-core sub-structure (Core 1...N) to show scale-out feeding a shared Core Allocator.
